github_mirror_contents: README.md, user_guide.md and images only; no LICENSE file and no source
distribution_notes: github.com/chaconlab/FRODOCK is only a documentation mirror with a single main branch, no tags, and no source code or licence file. The authoritative distribution is the chaconlab.org download frodock3_linux64.tgz, which contains prebuilt Linux x86_64 binaries, the C++ sources, the knowledge-based SOAP potential and the 1WEJ test case.
model_terms: FRODOCK ships no trained checkpoint. It consumes one immutable knowledge-based potential file, bin/soap.bin, which is part of the BSD-3-Clause release archive and is provisioned as a read-only asset.
build: The release archive ships prebuilt gcc (sequential) and Intel/MPI binaries plus full C++ sources. This Runner uses the sequential _gcc binaries because the default frodock binary requires Intel MKL shared libraries that the archive does not ship.
runtime_requirements: CPU only, sequential, no OpenMPI and no CUDA. The 3.12 test case documents roughly 40 minutes for the sequential version and about 11 minutes on four cores.
